name: CA-03
label: Safe D

key_factors: D+6 district with strong Democratic environment
Bera's huge financial advantage ($1.8M vs $16K cash)

model.rationale: The fundamentals point strongly to Bera: a D+6 seat, a favorable environment, incumbency, and a lopsided money edge over a barely funded challenger. Prediction markets at 95% for the Democrat confirm the picture, so the forecast stays near the baseline.
model.watch: Any late polling showing a much tighter race or unexpected outside spending against Bera would warrant a downgrade.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Ami Bera, the Democratic incumbent, is heavily favored in this Sacramento-area district that leans Democratic by six points. He has raised about $1.25 million and holds $1.8 million in cash, while Republican Robb Tucker has raised roughly $258,000 with only $16,000 on hand, leaving him little capacity to compete. No outside groups are spending meaningfully on either side.

No public general-election polls are available, so the outlook rests on district fundamentals, the money gap, and prediction markets, which price Bera's chances around 95 percent. With a favorable national environment for Democrats layered on top, this race sits in Safe D territory, with modest residual uncertainty from the absence of polling.
